measurement: Wall time around synchronous Omni.generate; initialization, output checking and file writing excluded
cache_policy: Persistent caches from initial same-node benchmark retained
seed_policy: Recreate CPU generator with the same manifest seed for every request
sampling: Diagnostic: 5 warmups, 3 full-step requests, 2 short warmups and one 2-step profiled request; not a replacement stabilized benchmark
labels: A completed case is called stable only when all three declared limits pass; otherwise its measured distribution is reported as unstable
